messages:
amanda.h: FYI planning a small deploy tonight to roll out the new observability dashboards + a tweak to high-latency alert thresholds. Targeting 22:00 UTC. Will run smoke checks and hold for 20m before full traffic. Who can be on smoke team?

jason: I can be on watch from 21:45 UTC. Will validate dash panels and traces. :eyes:

li: I can take the rollback window and run the health probes if anything looks off. What's the PR/commit?

amanda.h: PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 (obs/dash + alerts). Deploy will include: 1) Grafana dashboard import (dash v12), 2) alert threshold reduce from 400ms->350ms for tail latency, 3) tracing sampler bump to 1% for /generate endpoints.

denise: Quick ask — can we keep the old dashboard as a hidden copy in Grafana in case we need to revert visuals? That helped last time.

amanda.h: Yes, will snapshot current dash (grafana snapshot id: s-20260317-obsbackup) and annotate change log.

eva: For smoke checks, can we use this checklist?
- curl -sSf https://prod.redwood/api/health -> expect 200
- run ./scripts/smoke-checks.sh --samples 50 -> expect median latency < 180ms 
- grafana: load dashboard /dashboards/obs/overview -> check token cost panel and per-route latency heatmap
- traces: sample a few /generate spans in jaeger with tags: model, quant, seq_len

jason: Also will watch these alerts during the window: high_tail_latency_prod, qcache_miss_rate, inference_ooms. If any alert fires, call rollback.

li: Rollback plan: revert helm release to platform-chart@v1.14.2 and restore grafana dashboard from snapshot s-20260317-obsbackup. ETA for rollback < 12m if infra on-call has push privileges.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy window scheduled at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z. Watch party channel: #deploy-watch.

denise: small note — lowering alert threshold might trigger noisy paging during first 15m. Suggest mute paging for infra and route alerts to #deploy-watch for 15m and escalate only if sustained for 10m.

amanda.h: Good call. I'll set the routing rule: send to #deploy-watch for first 15m then restore normal on-call. Also will add a quiet period 0.5t on the high_tail_latency_prod alert to avoid flapping.

eva: Code review ping — PR 4321 is merged but I left a follow-up to adjust panel queries. I'll open a small PR to tweak percentile ranges; won't affect deploy.

jason: Sounds good. I’ll join the watch call at 22:00 UTC and take initial 0-20m smoke signoff.

li: I'll be ready for rollback if we see >5% tasks failing or p95 > 600ms. Will post a clear GO/NOGO at T+20.

amanda.h: Thanks all — I'll post the final deploy kickoff in 30m and paste smoke checklist and rollback commands. :rocket:
